name: monky
description: Monky — P2P Self-Hosted Voice, Video, Screen Share and Chat Application

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=packages/bot-sdk && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server
scripts.test: node scripts/test-versioning.js && node scripts/test-changelog.js && npm run test:light:scripts && npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:local-execution:integration --workspace=apps/server
scripts.test:light:scripts: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && node --test scripts/test-light-contracts.js scripts/test-light-build.js
scripts.test:light:voice: npm run build:light && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && node --test apps/light/test/headless_interop.test.cjs apps/light/test/browser_interop.test.cjs
scripts.test:light:hardware: npm run build:light && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && node --test apps/light/test/hardware_voice.cjs
scripts.measure:light: npm run build:light && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && node --test apps/light/test/resource_usage.cjs
